title: Choose the app shell and Dashboard layout
question: Three ways to lay out Keel's app around the same light look. Pick the one you want every app screen built on.

options.label: Accounts board
options.lineage: Kraken Pro home account cards, Gemini portfolio top bar
options.thesis: Your accounts lead: every account is a card with its P&L and how far it sits from its own limits.
options.viewport: Top bar with modules and account switcher; filter row; a row of account cards; combined equity chart; trades table.
options.risk: Thinner for a trader with a single account.

options.label: Inspector split
options.lineage: Copilot Money and Fey right-hand detail panels
options.thesis: Click any bar, day or row and a right-hand inspector shows the trades behind that number.
options.viewport: Narrow icon rail; filter bar; KPIs, equity and daily P&L in the main column; inspector on the right showing the selected day's trades.
options.risk: Less width for charts on 13-inch laptops.

options.label: Review desk
options.lineage: Kraken Pro home: labelled sidebar, value plus chart, tabbed table, right rail
options.thesis: A labelled sidebar and a working desk: performance in the middle, today's review and prop status in a right rail.
options.viewport: Labelled sidebar; filter bar; net P&L with equity curve and KPI strip; tabbed trades table; right rail with review queue, prop status and month calendar.
options.risk: Closest to the category standard; distinction rests on the details.
